The '''Kessel Trade Corridor''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] between [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] and [[Zerm/Legends|Zerm]]. Contrary to the [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]], it was the official route to Kessel.<ref name="TEA" />
